annotations.text: Everything in the first person on this band is a draft in the owner's voice: the three paragraphs and the three lines under the facts. The facts themselves (Google Maps; a biotech company through to going public; self-driving cars) were confirmed 2026-07-25. Confirm, reword or strike each sentence — biography is true-only. One to weigh: “these days I work on self-driving cars” is true, and tells a burned owner this is not his day job.

Option B reverses the 2026-08-05 retirement recorded in H-12. Nothing on the code side moves until the H-66 row is Chosen. Option A leaves every support line as it is today; the rest of the canvas stands either way.

The ledger's labels are the confirmed facts; its values are shipped product facts a visitor can check in the demo, so nothing in this band waits on H-66. The one new control is the link, at link weight. The hero's budget (one primary, one secondary) is untouched.
